rule: Pick sections by running the REAL buildSchedule() from SQE1_COLP_Revision.html in node against the server done-set (colp_progress.php). SEED_DATES are TEACHING dates, not due dates: the schedule = teaching date + 14 days, clamped to today, snapped to a free day, spread to 2026-12-14. Nothing is ever overdue, and the queue drains in TEACHING order (oldest first). Take Today then Upcoming. Then: (1) pdftotext the SLK manual chapter, (2) rebuild notes terse (15-25k chars, one point per line, citations only in the cases array, grep every case name back against the manual), (3) visuals array - overview mind map + one per topic + decision trees for confusable doctrines (map: 2-5 branches, grid: 2-4 cols), (4) preserve/relocate MCQ traps, never delete, (5) verify with the node buildVis sweep, (6) push the single file via a /tmp clone.
